rev.t: I recently purchased a set of 4 dining chairs from The Nine Wood at Jayanagar, I’m very happy with the entire experience, from booking to delivery. …

We have purchased sofa, chair, carpet, curtains and center table from Nine Wood. we totally loved the quality of the product. I would like to thank Jinendra Jain for his help through out the process of selecting, placing order and delivery. Highly recommend this place.

Very good experience of buying a customized dining table from Nine Woods. They patiently showed us all options and helped us choose the right product. The final delivered product was as per expectations. Very satisfied and must visit store!
